server: LabServer63 (main); root ~/rest_ato74; ~/rest_repr68, ~/rest_cover71, ~/rest_cmp72, ~/rest_src73 read-only (WL73 references, fit targets, runs)
operator: K_scatter[i,j,a,o,c] = d[i,a] sum_r A[r,a,c] T[i,j,r,c] O[r,o,c], d = 1 - beta (unchanged ballistic B), A = softmax(in_logits over r), O = softmax(out_logits over o), T >= 0 with sum_j T <= 1 per (source, r, c) (Euclidean projection onto the capped simplex, family68.project_capped). Then K >= 0, linear, zero input -> 0 and sum_{j,o} K <= d <= 1 for every rank M; 16 incoming / 64 outgoing bins unchanged

G0.basis: fixed WL68 net_all_5902 in/out logits (the WL72/73 A/O)

G1.basis: shared trainable logits fitted on the S16-R fitting population
G1.init: restart 0: WL68 logits; restarts 1, 2: N(0, 1) logits from the seeds

G2.basis: shared trainable logits (diagnostic capacity bound, not deployable)
G2.init: restart 0: each WL68 mixture duplicated + N(0, 0.01) (the G0 operator class up to the noise); restarts 1, 2: N(0, 1) logits

oracle.objective: WL68 objective J (family68.objective algebra, rank-generic copy ato74.objective_m): mean over (source, channel) of (native + fine16 + coarse)/3 + coarse contrast, relative per source
oracle.fitting_population: S16-R (12 kept S16 + 4 WL73 boundary sources) at rest and pt0: means of fitting replicas 0-3 (WL73 fit_targets73.pt); never an evaluation replica or a confirmation label
oracle.stage1_scoring: held-out replicas 4-7 of the same sources (eval73.load_refs), eval68 pooled (unbiased cross-replica, jackknife, upper 95 %)
oracle.algorithm: G1/G2: block coordinate descent, rounds x [per-source T: t_iters FISTA steps (warm start) | shared logits: ao_steps Adam steps (lr ao_lr) with T fixed]; then polish_iters FISTA steps of T at the final basis; float32. G0: polish_iters FISTA steps of T, then 2x polish more as a convex convergence check
oracle.stage2: each frozen basis (all restarts) on the WL73 confirmation sources (development evidence): per-source T fitted on replica 0 (float64 FISTA from 0.5/P, stage2_iters, then the same budget again from the solution as a convergence check), scored on replicas 1-3 (eval72 oracle split)
oracle.note: oracle values are achieved optimisation results, not certified global lower bounds; per-source T is source-specific latent data, never a transferable rule

decision.metrics: hi(G, m) = worst-channel upper 95 % bound, lo = worst-channel lower bound, m in {abs_coarse, con_coarse}
decision.stage3_gate: per G1 restart: valid (structural positivity / normalisation / passivity) AND [TRAIN_NEW_rest and _pt0 both meet abs_coarse <= 0.10 and con_coarse <= 0.25, OR both metrics <= 0.8 x G0 on both] AND BND_DEV (Stage 2) hi(G1) < lo(G0) for both metrics (beyond the measured uncertainty) AND no interior regression: hi <= 1.25 x G0 for both metrics on TRAIN_KEEP_rest, TRAIN_KEEP_pt0, INT_DED, REM_NEAR, FP_rest. The gate passes iff >= 2 of 3 G1 restarts pass; the Stage 3 basis is the passing restart with the lowest final fitting objective J (fitting replicas only)
decision.classes: A: gate passes and >= 2 G1 restarts meet all three WL59 gates (abs_coarse, abs_fine16, con_coarse) on TRAIN_NEW_rest/pt0 and BND_DEV; B: >= 2 G2 restarts are each <= 0.8 x every G1 restart (both metrics) on TRAIN_NEW_rest/pt0 and BND_DEV; C: none of {gate, G1 better than G0 (>= 2 restarts <= 0.8 x G0 on the boundary groups), G2 better than G0, B}; D: optimisation uncertainty - G1 or G2 restart spread of the final fitting objective > 10 %, or a convex T problem still changes > 1 % when its budget is doubled
decision.verdicts: FIXED BASIS LIMIT SUPPORTED if G1 better than G0 or the gate passes; RANK-8 GLOBAL BASIS ADEQUATE IN TESTED SCOPE if A and not B; HIGHER ANGULAR CAPACITY INDICATED if B (or G2 better than G0 while G1 is not); ANGULAR CHANGE DOES NOT ADDRESS PRIMARY ERROR if C, or if Stage 4 ran and gives NO LEARNED-K BENEFIT; INCONCLUSIVE if D dominates or a primary group is unmeasured; several may hold
decision.stage_flow: if the gate fails: report the oracle study and stop (no Stage 3/4). If only G2 improves: report and stop

stage3.rule: only if the Stage 3 gate passes: WL72 Candidate A (W+UV + L_sym, lambda 1) on S16-R with the chosen G1 basis frozen, exactly the WL73 AR recipe
stage3.controls: frozen WL73 AR_5901 / AR_5902 (WL68 A/O); angular pretraining cost (G1 fit seconds) is reported with the spatial cost

stage4.rule: only if Stage 3 ran; geometry-only population frozen here before any evidence (ports74.py)
stage4.exclusions: every previously scored source position and its exact images: WL66/68/71/72 referenced (slots 0-15, 20-27, 40-47), S16-R, all 29 WL73 confirmation ports

pose.rule: WL73 pose rule with te0 added to the probed poses: farthest dent centre from every D4 image of the probed centres; ties larger radius, name
pose.confound: cf1 (centre (4.5, -9.4) mm, R 24.5 mm, depth 5.0 mm) lies 4.4 mm from the pt0 training centre: DEF4 is a near-training-pose check

stage4.references: rest: slots 100-115, cf1: slots 110-115; K = 4; 32M photons; unchanged WL57 walker and gates; seeds 743000000 + g*1e6 + slot*1e4 + bin*100 + rep (rest 0, cf1 1); 1,408 packets
stage4.decision: A74 (G1 basis) vs AR (WL68 basis), two seeds each, three-valued (WL73 rule): far = better(BND4_FAR, 0.8); near = better(BND4_NEAR, 0.8); regression = worse(INT4, 1.25) or worse(TRAIN_KEEP_rest, 1.25). far OVERLAP -> INCONCLUSIVE; far YES -> LEARNED-K BENEFIT (TRADE-OFF if regression); far NO and near YES -> LOCAL BENEFIT ONLY; else NO LEARNED-K BENEFIT. DEF4 (cf1 - rest) reported separately (>= 4 qualified or UNMEASURED); spatial gap = learned error vs the same-basis oracle on BND4/INT4

prohibited: confirmation labels in angular or spatial fitting

execution.wrapper: run74.sh: dev smoke (root ~/rest_ato74_dev: 2 rounds / 5 iterations, 40-step fits, 0.5M-photon packets, Stage 3/4 forced in dev only to exercise the path) then the evidence chain; one detached process; Monitor armed
